Core primitives of Appouse.Safetalk: request canonicalization and HMAC-SHA256 signing/verification for secure server-to-server (B2B) communication.

Dependency-free contracts of Appouse.Safetalk (IHmacSignatureService, IHmacSecretProvider, IHmacReplayCache, header names). Reference this package from infrastructure/domain layers that implement secret stores or replay caches without taking a dependency on ASP.NET Core or HttpClient.
HttpClient integration for Appouse.Safetalk: a DelegatingHandler that signs outgoing requests with HMAC-SHA256 (X-Signature, X-Timestamp, X-Client-Id) and IHttpClientFactory registration helpers.
ASP.NET Core integration for Appouse.Safetalk: a middleware that verifies HMAC-SHA256 signed requests (X-Signature, X-Timestamp, X-Client-Id) with replay protection and pluggable secret providers.
